notes: Recommended checklist card from the visual spec (eyebrow line 35 verbatim, headline and points condensed from lines 37 and 39, footer line 39 verbatim). Numbered markers, never a ticked box, no Ads Manager mock-up (check_before_posting).

slides.headline: Before you call a campaign launched
items: Open the ad, scroll to Tracking.
Check that Website events is ticked with the right pixel.
Check that the pixel has fired recently.
slides.footer: A pixel that's connected but silent is the same as no pixel.
